concepts.name: 余烬·断穹
concepts.detail: Palette scarlet red with vermilion edges. Design: a huge angular guillotine-like hooked blade extending LEFT from the shaft top, broad solid wedge spine, three deliberate descending stepped facets along its OUTER spine, continuous sharp concave inner cutting edge, menacing long downward-pointing tip. A single elongated trapezoid cutout near the blade root; compact squared counterweight on right, octagonal shaft collars and sturdy faceted pointed pommel. Bold heavy brutal silhouette, not fine filigree. Tiny ember squares drifting off stepped spine.
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: fantasy Skyrim weapon mod design illustration. Create ONE full-length two-handed long-shaft WAR SCYTHE, geometric arcane energy construction. Portrait 1024x1536, centered complete weapon with generous margin, near-side orthographic three-quarter view showing thickness, isolated dark charcoal background. Crisp substantial beveled geometry, thick load-bearing shaft, two long smooth unobstructed hand grip areas on lower-middle shaft, very broad lethal sickle blade projecting sideways from TOP of shaft and curving down, unmistakably a scythe not an axe or spear. Entire construction made of colored luminous geometric energy, darker saturated faces and restrained bright edges; legible silhouette, modest bloom, no white overexposure. NO metal, wood, leather, crystal textures, skulls, wings, star symbols, magic circles, characters, text, labels, watermark. Small localized particles only near head. Feasible connected solid forms suitable for actual 3D game modeling. Palette scarlet red with vermilion edges. concepts.name: 流萤·萦月
concepts.detail: Palette deep emerald green with mint and teal edge accents. Design: a gracefully sweeping near-semicircular SINGLE crescent blade LEFT of top shaft, substantial double-rail crescent body separated by one long crescent-shaped negative space, attached at both ends near head socket but open inward below. Point curls inward downwards. Asymmetric S-shaped neck structurally connects crescent to straight shaft. Short leaf-shaped counterweight right. Long simple straight grip, open rhombus pommel. Entirely geometric faceted curves, no organic leaves or vines. Sparse tiny mint crescent motes nestled around blade.

concepts.name: 寒汐·截潮
concepts.detail: Palette cobalt blue faces, cyan and turquoise edge highlights. Design: an architectural extra-long low-profile scythe head extending LEFT horizontally, like a cantilever bridge ending in a dramatically downturned long triangular cutting hook. Two parallel horizontal structural beams with TWO large rectangular cutouts between them, wide continuous lower cutting surface sweeping into hook. Square offset mounting hub with short blunt right counterweight. A robust straight geometric shaft and compact stepped rectangular pommel. Very angular horizontal silhouette, no circular decorations, no crescent ring. Sparse short cyan streak particles along outer blade tip.

concepts.name: 梦隙·折夜
concepts.detail: Palette saturated violet and indigo faces with orchid and lilac luminous edges, no red. Design: elegant asymmetrical layered scythe head extending LEFT from top shaft. Three broad angular blade planes overlap at staggered depth like three folded paper ribbons, JOINED physically at a compact diamond hub. Together form ONE large sweeping downward scythe hook, longest upper plane ends in long descending point, two shorter inner planes echo it with clearly spaced narrow negative gaps. Each ribbon substantial and sharp, no floating disconnected parts. Short spear-like right counterweight angled upward, polygonal straight shaft, elongated diamond pommel. Sparse little violet triangular shards close to blade.
